This role is responsible for executing key Shipping, Receiving, Inventory Control and general replenishment and warehousing duties/tasks at The Coca-Cola Store and Store Support Center Warehouse.

The Warehouse receiver/driver position is responsible for performing general replenishment and warehousing duties to supporting The Coca-Cola Store Las Vegas.

These duties include loading, delivering, unloading, replenishment, order fulfillment, verifying/documenting receipts and shipments, inspecting orders, stand-up forklift operation, box trucks operational driving/support, inventory control and reconciliation. Safely follow the pick-up and delivery process.

Truck Operation, must have a valid Nevada Driver's License. Operator must pass DMV background check annually Individuals in this position must work cooperatively with others Associates and multiple groups and organizations. The individual must be self-motivated and have the ability to work effectively with little supervision.

The individual must also follow all company policies, procedures and safety standards. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Adheres to all company policies, procedures and safety standards. Familiarity with basic replenishment and warehousing operations. Accurately process paperwork.

Maintain warehouse organization, participate in the replenishment, shipping & receiving process, and order fulfillment. Accurately follow the MOS process and the RTV process. Maintain data integrity on micro level, participate in the material ticketing process. Communicate shortages/out-of-stocks to planners and retail operation.

Accurately utilize the KWI operation system. Must be available to work Monday through Friday primarily with weekends and rotational schedules when required. Supports and participates in all areas demonstrating good company stewardship. Works productively with little supervision. Participate in the Daily Work Prioritization for Support Center Team.

Performs additional duties as assigned by management. Operate company computers and appropriate software. Provide Support and Communication/Interaction with the Retail Store at The Coca-Cola Store (retail material, supplies, etc.), Move additional material as needed.

Education and/or Experience: High School Diploma or GED Equivalency required Certified forklift driver and/or at least three years of experience operating forklifts. Truck Operator with experience operating a 20ft+ Box Truck w/lift gate.

(Must be able to pass a DMV background check annually) Knowledge Skills and Abilities: Ability to effectively interact and communicate with others within the Retail Team, and all other support staffs and business contacts. Must have the ability for heavy repetitive lifting up to 50 lbs.

Ability to operate PC or main computers and utilize business related programs for inventory control and receiving, and have basic understanding of Word and Excel. Must be familiar with and capable of operating warehouse and delivery equipment. Ability to operate in a warehouse environment including extremes of heat, cold and height.

Understand basic replenishment and warehouse operations functions. Awareness of KO safety policies and procedures; includes the ability to identify and report safety hazards, safe operation of Company vehicles, proper PPE, and safe operation of industrial equipment.

Ability to change or adapt to work practices, priorities or procedures, or to reschedule activities in response to changing conditions or multiple work demands. Ability to work well with individuals in other groups, cooperate with others, offer help when needed, and foster a team climate where members are committed to a common goal.

Must be available to work weekend schedules when required. Equipment/Tools Utilized: Forklift (stand-up and sit down) Manual transmission delivery truck Symbol scanners Ticket blasters PC operation including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.

Office Equipment: Telephone, Copier/Fax/Printers Electric pallet jack, Manual pallet jack, Forklift Equipment for blocking and bracing material during transport Ladders, Dock leveler, hand truck, flat-bed cart Tape gun, glue gun, box cutter, shrink-wrap machine.

Physical Demands: Frequently required to stoop, stand, walk, climb, reach, push, pull, grasp, lift and use repetitive motions. Frequent lifting of materials/merchandise or equipment, some of which may be heavy (up to 50 lbs.) or awkward. Periodical exposure to heat, cold, and rain.

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position.

Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

Do you get excited about helping drivers land their next opportunity? US 1 Shorthaul is looking for a recruiter who thrives in a fast-moving environment and takes pride in connecting CDL and driver candidates with career opportunities that can make a meaningful impact on their lives. This role is centered on driver recruiting .

The person in this seat will spend the vast majority of their time recruiting, screening, and guiding CDL and driver candidates through the hiring process. This is not a broad recruiting role with a light driver component.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with drivers, understands the importance of the details, and can keep hiring momentum moving in a high-priority environment. The right person will be proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and strong with follow-through.

They will be comfortable working across multiple systems, maintaining accurate records, and helping ensure candidates meet minimum hiring and safety requirements. While recruiters have assigned sites and core ownership, this team works with a shared-support mindset.

We partner closely, communicate openly, and step in to help one another when priorities shift or workloads spike. The right person will be able to take ownership of their work while also contributing as a strong team player.

Key Responsibilities: Recruit primarily for CDL and driver positions Communicate with candidates by phone, email, and recruiting platforms Build relationships with driver candidates and guide them through the hiring process from first contact through next steps Screen candidates carefully to confirm qualifications, work history, and minimum safety requirements Utilize multiple systems and tools to track applicants, verify information, and maintain accurate candidate records Coordinate candidate movement through the hiring process in a timely and organized manner Maintain detailed notes, strong follow-up, and clear communication throughout the process Partner with internal leaders regarding hiring priorities, candidate status, and recruiting progress Team-oriented mindset with the ability to own assigned sites while also stepping in to support broader team priorities when needed Help create a positive candidate experience and strong first impression of US 1 Shorthaul What We’re Looking For: Experience in transportation, CDL, or driver recruiting (preferred) Strong attention to detail and the ability to catch small issues before they become bigger problems Highly proactive work style with strong ownership and urgency Excellent communication and follow-through Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Comfort using multiple systems to track candidate progress and hiring activity Ability to work independently while staying aligned with team and business needs Someone who genuinely enjoys driver recruiting and is energized by a detail-heavy, fast-paced environment Why this role matters: At US 1 Shorthaul , every hire matters.

We are looking for someone who will create a positive experience for candidates while helping us bring in safe, qualified drivers who fit how we operate. About US 1 Shorthaul : US 1 Shorthaul supports transportation and logistics operations across the country, with a strong focus on safety, service, and reliability.

We are looking for team members who communicate well, move with urgency, and take pride in the impact their work makes.

Benefits and Perks: Weekly Pay Paid Time Off Health Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance 401(k) with Company Match Employer-Paid Life Insurance Employer-Paid AD&D Insurance Additional voluntary benefits Apply now to join the US 1 Shorthaul team! US 1 Shorthaul is an Equal Employment Opportunity ("EEO") Employer.

In keeping with our commitment, we welcome all to apply including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

US 1 Shorthaul does not discriminate against employees or applicants on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state, and/or local laws. #zr Originally posted on Himalayas

BINGO is a fully integrated recycling and resource management company, providing innovative solutions across the entire waste management supply chain in Queensland, New South Wales, and Victoria. We are excited about our growth journey, and now we’re looking for a dedicated Loader Driver to join our Revesby team for night shift operations. Together, we’ll drive change, shape the future of our industry, and work towards making Australia waste free.
We are seeking experienced Rear Loader Drivers to support our commercial and industrial waste collection operations in Revesby during night shifts . If you’re a reliable, safety-conscious driver with a passion for working in a fast-paced environment, this is your opportunity to join a company that values its people and their contributions.
If you're an experienced driver looking for a company that truly cares about its people — you've just found your next move.

Operate loader trucks to collect and transport commercial and industrial waste in Revesby during night shifts.
Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and traffic regulations.
Conduct daily pre ‑ shift vehicle inspections and report any issues.
Assist with loading waste and ensure proper handling of materials.
Maintain a high level of customer service and professionalism.
Follow all safety policies and procedures, including fatigue management.
Report incidents, near misses, and complete necessary documentation.
What Makes You a GOgetter
A current and valid NSW HR or HC licence.
Minimum 12 months experience operating loader trucks or in the commercial waste industry.
Experience working night shifts in industrial or commercial areas preferred.
Full working rights in Australia.
A clean and up-to-date driving record.
Strong communication skills and a customer-focused attitude.
Reliable, flexible, and safety-focused with a positive "can-do" attitude.
Ability to pass a medical check.
What You Receive As a GOgetter
Weekly pay for all GOgetters.
$1500 employee referral bonus for every friend you bring into the BINGO family.
Genuine training, career development, and progression opportunities.
A safety-driven, people-first culture.
Employee benefits including novated leasing, discounted health insurance, retail discounts, and our recognition program.
Supportive team environment committed to diversity and inclusion.
We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and individuals from culturally diverse backgrounds.
If you’re ready to make a difference and join a forward-thinking company committed to sustainability and community, apply now!

Die MZ Dienstleistungs AG ist seit 2007 ein etablierter und führender Personaldienstleister für das Transportgewerbe und den öffentlichen Verkehr in der Deutschschweiz.

Unsere Spezialisierung auf Lkw- und Buschauffeure ermöglicht es uns, unseren Mitarbeitenden abwechslungsreiche Einsätze, langfristige Perspektiven und eine persönliche Betreuung zu bieten. Ergänzt wird unser Angebot durch schweizweite Express- und Gütertransporte sowie Beratungsdienstleistungen in den Bereichen Transport und Logistik.
Steig bei uns ein! Für unser motiviertes Team suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Chauffeur/in Kat. C (30–80 %) für abwechslungsreiche Einsätze bei verschiedenen Kunden. Dich erwarten vielseitige Aufgaben in den Bereichen Stückgut, Lebensmittel, Elektrohaushaltsgeräte und Schmierstoffe
**Was Arbeiten bei uns besonders macht:**
* Vielseitige und abwechslungsreiche Einsätze – Langeweile kommt bei uns garantiert nicht auf.
* Jährlich kostenloser CZV-Kurs, damit dein CZV-Nachweis immer gültig bleibt.
* Gesellige Mitarbeiterevents wie unsere Weihnachtsfeier oder ein Sommer-Grillfest.
* Möglichkeit, neue Fähigkeiten und Fahrzeugtypen direkt im Arbeitsalltag kennenzulernen und dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
* Ob Teilzeit, arbeiten in einem System oder eine längere Auszeit – gemeinsam finden wir ein Arbeitsmodell, das zu deinem Leben passt.
**So sieht dein Arbeitsalltag aus:**
* Du bist bei verschiedenen Kunden im Einsatz und sorgst dafür, dass die Ware sicher und zuverlässig ans Ziel kommt.
* Deine Einsätze sind abwechslungsreich und umfassen insbesondere folgende Bereiche:
* Auslieferung von Tiefkühlprodukten
* Auslieferung von Elektrohaushaltsgeräten wie Kühlschränken, Waschmaschinen usw.
* Auslieferung von Schmierstoffen
* Auslieferung von allgemeinem Stückgut
* Du hältst die geltenden Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie die gesetzlichen Lenk- und Ruhezeiten konsequent ein.
* Du gehst verantwortungsbewusst mit deinem Fahrzeug um und sorgst für dessen Sauberkeit, Pflege und Werterhalt.
* Du trittst bei unseren Kunden professionell und freundlich auf und repräsentierst unser Unternehmen zuverlässig.
**So passt du zu uns:**
* Führerausweis der Kategorie C inklusive gültiger Fahrerkarte und gültigem CZV-Nachweis.
* Erfahrung im Bereich Stückgut- oder Warenverteilung von Vorteil.
* Deutschkenntnisse auf mind. Niveau B1 (mündlich und schriftlich)
* Selbstständige, zuverlässige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise.
* Sicherer und verantwortungsbewusster Umgang mit dem Fahrzeug und der transportierten Ware.
* Kundenorientiertes Auftreten und Freude am täglichen Kontakt mit unterschiedlichen Kunden.
* Körperlich fit, und belastbar. Das Be- und Entladen ist die Aufgabe des Chauffeurs
* Flexibel, motiviert und offen für abwechslungsreiche Einsätze bei verschiedenen Kunden.Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? - Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Job Description
Purpose
As Chauffeur / Executive Driver, you will ensure the safe, proactive, and discreet execution of driving duties for the CEO, senior leadership, and VIP guests. You will deliver a highly professional, representative and service-oriented driving experience, ensure the operational readiness and safety of the company vehicle, seamlessly support key logistical and administrative tasks for both Executive/Board Services and Facility Management, actively contributing to projects and archiving activities.
Accountabilities
Executive Driving
Conduct driving assignments for the CEO, senior leadership, and VIP guests within Switzerland (and internationally/near borders as required).
Provide safe, smooth, and comfort-oriented driving; maintain situational behavior under elevated security requirements.
Ensure professional reception, care, and logistics for visitors/guests (e.g., at airports/hotel), including luggage handling and coordination with reception/security.
Perform independent route and schedule planning, proactively considering traffic, roadworks, weather, security situations, and alternative routes.
Execute courier trips, errands, and transport sensitive documents/materials with the utmost care and confidentiality.
Coordinate and prioritize driving assignments; align with the CEO Office, Executive Assistants, and Board Secretariat.
Demonstrate high flexibility (e.g., short-term changes, waiting times, evening appointments) within the framework of working hours regulations.

Das Unternehmen bietet geregelte Arbeitszeiten, ein kollegiales Team und ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima. Ergänzt wird dies durch attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen.
